messages: Marta: dropped a compact heatmap mock with p95 overlay + micro-hist below. quick q: control label for sample control - 'Sampling', 'Sample rate', or something else? Alex: 'Sample rate' is clearer. communicates it's a percentage/ratio. Jun: agree. also show the numeric value next to the slider (e.g. '10%') so it's not ambiguous. Sam: scrubber behavior: currently snaps to bucket centers and that's confusing when buckets are sparse. can we make it snap to actual event times when sufficiently zoomed? Marta: design idea: elastic snapping - bucket snap at low zoom, event snap when zoom < 8m. will prototype. Ravi: backend note: requesting exact event positions will increase load. we can add a flag param like exact=true only when client needs it. Alex: debounce UX: changing sample quickly causes heavy queries. prefer live update with debounce ~300ms + small inline spinner to show updating. Aria (a11y): accesibility: ensure control announces value changes e.g., 'Sample rate 10 percent' via aria-live. spinner should have role="status" and say 'Updating heatmap'. tooltip must be keyboard-focusable. Jun: example snippet I'll paste in figma comments: ``` Sample rate 10% ``` Marta: copy question: we use an 'Auto' mode that adapts to traffic. should we call it 'Adaptive' or 'Auto'? Sam: 'Adaptive' is clearer, but longer. show short label + info icon with tooltip: 'Adaptive: adjusts sample rate based on traffic and p95 variance.' Alex: I'll add that tooltip text in figma. prefer short visible label with hover/tap reveal. Ravi: I'll add a backend task to honor debounce and add the exact-times flag. will add perf test. Jun: p95 legend microcopy: change tooltip to '95th percentile latency (ms) — latency experienced by the slowest 5% of requests.' users keep asking what p95 means. Aria (a11y): small a11y checklist for handoff: keyboard nav, aria-live for value, spinner role=status, accessible tooltip. I'll run a quick screen-reader pass in review. Marta: Handoff acceptance: 1) Label set to 'Sample rate' + visible percent; 2) 'Adaptive' option with tooltip copy; 3) debounce ~300ms + aria role=status spinner + aria-live value updates; 4) elastic scrubber snapping documented + backend exact-times flag; 5) p95 legend microcopy updated. Objections? Alex: LGTM, adding comments. Sam: I'll scope the perf impact and ticket the backend. design-bot: Reminder: design review in 15m in #design. Figma -> https://figma.com/file/abc123/mini-heatmap Marta: thanks team, see you there :thumbsup:
